newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said on Monday.

"Government securities were narrowly mixed today amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market. Treasury bills were narrowly mixed while bond prices slightly lower. Volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.50/1.45 percent compared with last Friday's yield of 1.40/1.35 percent and one-year at a yield of 1.82/1.77 percent against 1.85/1.80 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$98.63/98.68 from last Friday's close of S$98.70/98.75, September 2001 at S$97.20/97.25 versus S$97.35/97.40 and June 2003 at S$95.20/95.25 against S$95.38/95.43.
The overnight interbank offered rate was unchanged from last Friday's 3-1/4 3-1/8 percent.
